subject: manual changes should go with features

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: manual changes should go with features
parts:
I just fixed the manual pull request to change
a bogus "descriptions" element to "description"
in the description of the to_vector() function.

I should've been clearer. I thought if people had
corrections to the manual, they could add them to
my manual correction pull request. But I think we should
keep manual updates for new features together with the new
feature so it can all be added or dropped together.

Does that make sense?

If the manual settles down, I can break it apart
into more included files so we're less likely to
get merge conflicts in the future.

- Bob
